scope: Development sample; validation of extraction and attribution, not a measure of news importance or generalization.
read_path: Opt-in bounded source read. No rebuild or write to the DuckDB archive. Legacy reads JSON metadata; v2 validates parser version, raw length, checksum, and migration overlay before using GKG themes, location mentions and named people/organisations. Payloads larger than 256 KiB, malformed rows, or unsupported versions remain eligible by headline. A country is inferred from document mentions, not publisher country or action location. Unknown facets are allowed.
genre_limits: A positive genre cue is evidence about the wording of a title. It is not verification of an action, and unmarked headlines retain unknown/neutral genre. Rules cover limited English and Chinese wording.
